// diagnostic

E1131

`#As` is on computed field `{name}`.

What

`#As` is on computed field `{name}`.

Why

`#As` passes the struct as a stored field's value, and a computed field stores none.

Fix

Put `#As` on a stored field, or remove it.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E1131: tests/ui/as_refusals.stderr.

Error [jet.AsRepeated]: `Pin` already passes as its field `at`
  --> tests/ui/as_refusals.jet:8:5
    |
  8 |     #As home: Point
    |     ^^^
 Why: A struct passes as one field, so only one of its fields carries `#As`
 Fix: Remove `#As` from all but one field
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E1129

Error [jet.AsComputed]: `#As` is on computed field `size`
  --> tests/ui/as_refusals.jet:13:5
    |
 13 |     #As size: Int -> 3
    |     ^^^
 Why: `#As` passes the struct as a stored field's value, and a computed field stores none
 Fix: Put `#As` on a stored field, or remove it
